_source: Study design parameters and frozen configuration, final corrected state.

oversized_stop_split.mapping: 5 stops split into 2 virtual stops each; 1 stop split into 3
oversized_stop_split.mechanism: A canonical virtual-stop mapping (src/data.py) is the single source of truth for every node ID used anywhere in the pipeline -- customer attributes, matrix lookups (split pieces resolve to their parent physical node), demand, service time, and time windows. Every lookup is a hard failure on a miss; there is no silent fallback.

err_robustness.sa_nr_scope: full 51 held-out instances x 3 triggers, seed=101, 20 resamples/block (3,060 scenarios)
err_robustness.liu_alns_scope: STRATIFIED 11-instance computational-robustness subset (NOT full 51-instance validation), 3 triggers, seed=101, 10 resamples/block (330 scenarios)
err_robustness.stratification_rule: every 5th instance from the sorted 51-instance list

vehicle_capacity.note: Frozen study parameter: vehicle capacity limits used by the oversized-stop-split logic (src/data.py).

default_service_time_min.note: Frozen study parameter: fallback service time (minutes) used when service_time_min_baseline is not positive in the source data.

quantile_bootstrap_ci95.note: OD-pair cluster-bootstrap (5,000 resamples) 95% CIs for the frozen quantile_multipliers, for reference/reporting.
